name: Mounted STOP sign (candidate)

status.quarantine: Development candidate. Not release content. Nothing here grants source, content or reuse approval.

meaningSources.quote: Stop before the white line. Give way to traffic from the right and left.

part.partAttachmentNote: back_centre is the centre of the 600 x 600 backing in the asset frame (F0 asset); the octagon is centred on the backing. Source does not give a fixing-point offset.

assetFrame.note: Identical to the F0 FaceProfile for sg.mandatory.stop: the face reads correctly to an observer standing on the -Y side looking toward +Y.

worldPlacement.frontNormalRule: frontNormal = rotateZ(assetFront, pose.yaw). The face is legible only from the half-space on its frontNormal side; there is no camera-facing rotation.
worldPlacement.approachRule: frontNormal must oppose the governed approach heading: dot(frontNormal, [cos h, sin h, 0]) < 0, where h = intendedApproach.heading. Faces are placed so approaching drivers see the front.
worldPlacement.upRule: up stays world +Z; the sign is plumb on its post.

worldExamples.note: Matches the F0 fixture world sg-stop-access-001 (development access westbound; sign on the left verge at y = -3.85, x = 7.5). rotateZ((0,-1,0), pi/2) = (1,0,0).

worldPlacement.leftTrafficPlacementNote: LEFT traffic: the default roadside for a single sign is the left verge of the governed approach. This is a scenario convention, not a SUP/TFM/TP statement.

compatibleSupports.heightBasis: derived: SUP6 2400 mm sign bottom + 300 mm half backing height
compatibleSupports.applicability: Dedicated post at a development-access / minor-road approach; the 600 x 600 face is within SUP6's 900 x 1000 maximum.

compatibleSupports.heightBasis: derived: SUP5 2400 mm sign bottom + 300 mm half backing height
compatibleSupports.applicability: Existing lamp post or vertical support; '600 & BELOW' holder variant. SUP5's 2400 mm belongs to that shown assembly only.

compatibleSupports.heightBasis: unknown: SUP7 states no installation height
compatibleSupports.applicability: Offset holder for a 600 x 600 sign on an existing post; any height used in a world is a scenario decision.

compatibleSupports.heightBasis: derived: SUP15 2400 mm sign bottom + 300 mm half backing height
compatibleSupports.applicability: Arterial ('major') approaches only; outside the F0 face's minor-road contexts unless a world extends allowedContexts.

excludedSupports.reason: SUP4 low roadside support: height clearance 500-1200 mm is intended for sharp-deviation / Keep Left / Pass Either Side signs (SUP4 note 1); not a STOP mount.
SUP7 wall variant is a wall_bracket family with no installation height; not part of the first slice.
SUP15 expressway variant (2.3 m2, SHS 100 x 100 x 4) is for expressway signs; STOP is not an expressway control here.
F0 development post is schematic_unsourced (2100 mm top_face_mount). Kept only as the current fixture fallback; superseded by the SUP6 candidate once integrated.

governedApproach.intendedApproach: the development-access / minor approach that must stop
governedApproach.applicableLanes: every entry lane of the governed approach that reaches the stop line
governedApproach.applicableMovements: every movement leaving the governed approach (left turn, right turn, straight where present)

linkedControlLine.placementRule: The sign is placed on the approach side of its linked stop line; the longitudinal distance between sign and line is not given by TFM1, TP or SUP. The J paint shared with the paved-shoulder boundary keeps a separate semantic role.

meaning.text: Stop before the white line. Give way to traffic from the right and left.

measurements.name: backing_width
measurements.endpoints: left outer backing edge to right outer backing edge

measurements.name: backing_height
measurements.endpoints: top outer backing edge to bottom outer backing edge

measurements.name: sign_bottom_above_ground_sup6
measurements.endpoints: ground to bottom edge of sign on the SUP6 single post support

measurements.name: sign_bottom_above_ground_sup5
measurements.endpoints: ground level to bottom edge of sign on the SUP5 vertical support
notes: Applies only to the SUP5 shown assembly.

unknowns: longitudinal distance from the sign to the stop line
lateral offset of the post from the kerb / lane edge
post height above ground for every support candidate
fixing-point offset between the post and the backing centre (rivet/stiffener stack)
whether a second face is required for a multi-lane approach
sourceGaps: No official source in the collection states a mounting height for a STOP sign in general; the 2400 mm values are per-assembly labels on SUP5, SUP6 and SUP15.
TFM1 gives the 600 x 600 backing only; it does not show a support.
TP handbook page 10 gives meaning only; no geometry.
warnings: Do not read 2400 mm as a universal mounting rule.
The F0 fixture currently mounts this face at 2100 mm on a schematic post; that value has no source and must not be promoted.

fixtureCrossReference.currentSupport: sg.dev.sign-post-schematic at top_face_mount, heightAboveGroundM 2.1, dimensionsStatus schematic_unsourced
fixtureCrossReference.integrationNote: I1 may swap the fixture support for sg.candidate.support-sup6-single-post at 2.7 m (face_back_centre_600_panel) without touching the face asset. Keep dimensionsStatus 'sourced' only for the support; the sign-to-line distance stays a scenario decision.
